tools.name: list_charts
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find charts in their saved library. Returns paginated metadata and URLs, not chart documents; requires authentication. Draft-only editor charts have publishedAt null, hasDraft true, and sizeBytes 0 because sizeBytes measures only the stored published document, not dra

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user identifies a saved chart by id and wants to view it or retrieve its metadata and URLs. Displays the published chart when available and does not return its document; requires authentication.

tools.name: get_chart_document
tools.description: Use this when the user identifies a saved chart by id and needs its complete published Szum document for inspection or reuse, or an earlier version's document from list_chart_versions. Does not return a newer editor draft; requires authentication.

tools.name: list_chart_versions
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see a saved chart's earlier publications, find one to read with get_chart_document, or pick one to restore with restore_chart_version. Returns versions newest first with who published each, from where and what changed; requires authentication.

tools.name: get_preview_state
tools.description: Use this when the Szum chart App needs to restore a rendered preview as its current transient or saved view. It is read-only, owner-scoped when authenticated, and hidden from the model.

tools.name: update_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to replace and publish a saved chart's document while keeping its id and URLs. Validate each generated or changed chart input once before rendering, saving, or updating. Do not revalidate unchanged input; a successful render preflights it for later saves or updates. Erro

tools.name: restore_chart_version
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a saved chart to go back to an earlier version from list_chart_versions. Publishes that version's document again as a new version, keeping the chart's id and URLs, so the version it replaces stays restorable. Refuses charts with unpublished editor changes; requires authe

tools.name: rename_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change a saved chart's library title without changing its document, publication state, or public URLs; requires authentication.

tools.name: delete_chart
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants to permanently delete one saved chart. Deletion cannot be undone, and retrying an already completed deletion succeeds; requires authentication.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: Use this when choosing a visual theme for a chart. Returns every built-in theme with guidance on where each works best and, when signed in, the workspace's shared themes.

tools.name: validate_chart
tools.description: Use this when a chart request or document will be rendered, saved, or updated. Validate each generated or changed chart input once before rendering, saving, or updating. tools.name: list_chart_types
tools.description: Use this when choosing a chart family. Returns every current chart type with its shared and family-specific fields.

tools.name: get_examples
tools.description: Get complete Szum documents for validation, rendering, or saving, with guidance on when to use each pattern. No filters returns one starter per chart type. tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Use this before authoring an unfamiliar field instead of probing validate_chart for errors. Returns the JSON Schema for the whole Szum document, covering config, data, presentation, size, and output, with every referenced definition included. Pass chart_type to keep only that family's config variant

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_charts, get_chart, validate_chart · Private data: save_chart, list_charts, get_chart, get_chart_document, update_chart, restore_chart_version, rename_chart, validate_chart, get_examples, get_schema · Public sink: save_chart, update_chart · Destructive: render_chart, save_chart, update_chart, delete_chart, validate_chart, get_examples.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_charts, get_chart, validate_chart · Private data: save_chart, list_charts, get_chart, get_chart_document, update_chart, restore_chart_version, rename_chart, validate_chart, get_examples, get_schema · Public sink: save_chart, update_chart · Destructive: render_chart, save_chart, update_chart, delete_chart, validate_chart, get_examples

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_chart_document" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this when the user identifies a saved chart by id and needs its complete published Szum document for inspection or reuse. Does not return a newer editor draft; requires authentication." → after: "Use this when the user identifies a saved chart by id and needs its complete published Szum document for inspection or reuse, or an earlier version's document from list_chart_versions. Does not return a newer editor draft; requires authentication."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
